result.brief: 提出线性可解码性监督（LDS）辅助目标，增强世界动作模型中指令目标信息的可解码性与行为控制，并用先验-指令竞争机制解释其作用。
result.reason: Studies instruction grounding in world action models via linear decodability of target information and an auxiliary representation-supervision objective, with causal analysis of prior-instruction competition.
